Warning Clash Visualizer

Turn a Revit warning into a focused 3D review.

Open project warnings in one list, then isolate, color-code, and zoom to the affected elements in a reusable 3D view.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Go from a warning message to the location that needs attention

A warning tells you what Revit detected. Open it in a dedicated section-box view so the team can see which elements are involved and decide how to resolve it.

  • 01

    Central Warning List

    Displays all project warnings in a detailed table with error messages, element counts, and specific element details

  • 02

    Smart 3D Warning View

    Automatically generates or reuses a dedicated 3D view named 'WarningView' specifically for visualizing issues

  • 03

    Auto-Isolation

    Instantly isolates only the conflicting elements of the selected warning, clearing previous overrides automatically

  • 04

    Precise Section Box

    Calculates the exact bounding box around the clashing elements and applies it with a safe offset (4 feet / ~1.2 meters)

  • 05

    Multi-Color Coding

    Uses a pre-defined 8-color palette to paint each clashing element a different color for instant visual differentiation

  • 06

    Solid Surface Fills

    Applies high-contrast solid surface fills and projection colors for optimal visibility

  • 07

    Auto-Zoom & Select

    Automatically selects the clashing elements and zooms in (ShowElements) to focus on the issue area

  • 08

    Smart View Reuse

    Avoids cluttering the project by reusing the 'WarningView' and cleaning up old overrides rather than creating new views

  • 09

    Grouping by Category

    Internally categorizes conflicting elements by category for better tracking
